title: Cheap and Melty
text:
Cheap and Melty. We cook a lot of bacon in the microwave so this cooker seemed like a good fit for us. It wasn't. This is one of the worse selections I have made for my kitchen and cannot recommend it.

The main issue that it has comes down to a complete lack of quality. Everything about this cooker says "cheap". It is cheap, flimsy plastic inside and out. The inner fins over which you drape the bacon are softer plastic and it blisters and melts far too easily.

The one redeeming value of this cooker is that it keeps the mess contained. However, since the plastic melts so easily, there's not much motivation to use it in the first place. If the fins had been ceramic or glass, this could have been a much better product that would have cost marginally more.

I can't recommend this, unless perhaps to offer it as a drippings container. It's a cheap product that barely holds up under use.
